# Copilot project scope

All repository work concerns Credo Africa Identity only.

Mzansi Tax App is a separate project. Never inspect, modify, migrate, deploy,
merge, or include Mzansi Tax App repositories, Supabase projects, databases,
schemas, migrations, credentials, application logic, or security findings in
Credo work.

If another project's resources are encountered, stop and report them rather
than incorporating them.
